calm.description: Nothing happens: small moves on ordinary volume.

selloff.description: About -0.8 % in the first 15 minutes on 3x volume, then -1.5 % to -1.9 %.

sharp_selloff.description: About -2.6 % in the first 15 minutes on 5x volume, then -4 %.

rally.description: About +0.9 % in the first 15 minutes on 3x volume, then +1.6 % to +1.9 %.

pump.description: A vertical +3 % to +4.6 % spike on 6-7x volume.

dip_low_volume.description: Price dips about -0.6 % to -1 % but volume stays near normal (1.1x-1.3x): not a confirmation.

volume_no_move.description: Volume spikes (2-3x) but price barely moves: not a confirmation.

drift_down.description: A slow drift lower on ordinary volume: too small to confirm anything.

late_selloff.description: Calm for the first 15 minutes, then a crash in candles that close only after the decision time (a look-ahead trap).

whipsaw.description: A -1.3 % drop on 3.6x volume that fully reverses in the next candle.
